prompts.emberheart: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original inventory item icon for Emberfell, a medieval fantasy RPG. Subject: the EMBERHEART RELIC, an ancient bronze scarab reliquary from a buried desert pyramid. A compact, symmetrical, roughly upright oval scarab artifact with angular CLOSED bronze wing plates and a glowing molten orange-red cabochon core in its thorax, small inset ember cracks, worn hammered golden-bronze trim, three compact stepped pyramid ridges on its top, a tiny dark pointed lower end. This is an ornamental handheld archaeological relic, not a living insect. Clearly distinct from a flame symbol, heart, generic gemstone, necklace or potion. Style: polished hand-painted fantasy loot icon, slightly exaggerated readable silhouette, crisp dark brown outlines, bold rich color blocks, detailed highlights but legible at 128 by 128 pixels, a subtle three-quarter view with most of the front visible, upper-left light. Entire single item centered with ample clear padding on every side. Full transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no tile, no frame, no ground shadow, no glow outside the artifact, no text, no labels, no other objects. The object fills about 78 percent of a square canvas.
